purpose: Opens a vault's pictures in the full-screen viewer: the small copy shows at once while the largest stored copy is fetched with the person's access, a picture on this device opens with no fetch, and the viewer's stylesheet is loaded for you.

source.repo: KaiGilb/GilbPlatformCode (written new from PictureRecords run 7 and run 6, local folders that are not git repositories)

namedChanges: V1. resolveSrc signs item.fileUri and answers the local URL for an item with none; openStored puts the largest copy in fileUri (run 7 chose it inside resolveSrc)
V2. openStored's thumbnail address is thumbUriOf(copies, master) ?? master (run 7 showed no stand-in while copies was null)
V3. el (focus return) is passed through to the viewer's item

library.title: Vault picture viewer (open a stored picture full screen, signed)
library.note: Opens a vault picture in the full-screen viewer: thumbnail first, then the largest copy, both fetched signed; also a local picture with no fetch. Loads the viewer's CSS itself. Needs picture-viewer, signed-picture and picture-set.
